title: Rav Chinena bar Chiya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Ketubot 21a he objects to Rav Yehudah: “Did Shmuel say this? What about the document issued by Mar Shmuel’s court?” etc. Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim, at the beginning of chapter 3, has Rabbi Chanina, son of Rabbi Bechayi. Hyman suggests son of Rav Chiya, with the bet displaced. Hyman cites the Rosh on Pesachim 2:13 as reading Rabbi Chanina ben Pedai asking Rabbi Mana.

notes.text: Hyman proposes that a displaced bet produced Bechayi instead of Rav Chiya. Pedai is a further cited variant; the forms are retained.

The consulted Rosh, Pesachim 2:13, has Chanina son of Pedai asking Rabbi Ami. Its preceding account has Shmuel bar Yitzchak asking Rabbi Mana. Hyman’s assignment of Mana to Chanina is retained as supplied, with this addressee difference explicit. Ketubot 21a also gives alternative questioners Huna bar Yehudah and Chiya bar Yehudah.
